Tuition and Financial Support
Tuition, Remission & Stipends
A Baylor education is a great opportunity to join a nationally recognized university in a city with a low cost of living to help keep your investment manageable. At the master’s level, Baylor’s School of Engineering and Computer Science offers a scholarship of up to 50% of the tuition cost — that’s $36,500 for the 2025– 2026 academic year. ECS Class of 2024 master’s students had a 93% career success rate and an average salary of $96,000. Nearly all incoming Ph.D. students receive full tuition remission and a multi-year research or teaching assistantship.
